## **Project Description**

### Multiscale fishery variability

This repository contains the code to replicate the statistical analyses and figures presented in the manuscript:

> **Compaire, J.C., Irigoyen, A.J., Simionato, C.G. & Acha, E.M. (2026).** Multiscale environmental forcing of multispecies fishery dynamics across climate timescales. Submitted to *Fisheries Oceanography*. [{{< fa link >}} DOI: https://doi.org/XXXXX](https://doi.org/XXXXX)
